summary: Synergy CHC Corp. filed an 8-K to report an equity purchase agreement with Hudson Global Ventures, LLC. The agreement gives Synergy the right, but not obligation, to direct the investor to purchase up to $36 million of common stock over 24 months at a discount (95% of certain price benchmarks). The filing represents a committed equity facility (standby equity distribution agreement), not a transformative M&A event. It is a routine financing arrangement for working capital. No premium, change of control, board recommendation, or risk-arb angle applies; the event is an at-the-market financing mechanism with no special-situation characteristics.
